title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-1ror: transcript_4 parameter ciphertext_3 misnamed, should be plaintext_3
description: The `transcript_4` function (edhoc.rs:542) names its second parameter `ciphertext_3` but per EDHOC RFC 9528 §4.5, TH_4 = H(TH_3, PLAINTEXT_3, CRED_I). Both callers now pass plaintext correctly (line 1201: `&plaintext_3`, line 1631: `&pending.plaintext`), but the parameter name is misleading and could cause future maintainers to mistakenly pass ciphertext.
